title: Nile Infinity Tours
blurb: Nile Infinity Tours offers luxury Nile River cruises and Egypt tours departing from the USA. They provide services including drivers, Egyptologists, airport liaisons, and various local guides. Tipping is customary but not obligatory, with suggested amounts provided for different service roles.
extraNote: Tipping is customary but not obligatory; suggested amounts: Drivers $12-15 per day per person, Egyptologist $20-25 per day per person, Airport liaison $10-12 per person per transfer, Hotel $5-7 per person per day, Restaurants 10%-20%, Bathroom .25 cents (5 Egyptian Pounds), Felucca/Sailboat driver $3-5 per person, Horse carriage driver $3-5 per person.
